alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A dark bedroom with a bed and a phone. A yellow block figure with white eyes and a flat red crown, awake, looks at the phone as its screen lights up, leans toward it, then settles with closed eyes; the phone lights up again and the film ends exactly as it began. White subtitles at the bottom read: 2:47 AM. She checked. Nothing came. She will check again. 2:47 AM.
